title: So Self - a self-compassion and social media literacy based mHealth body image training. A Randomized Controlled Trial.
summary:
The SoSelf App Training is a digital program for girls and young women aged 14 to 21 that aims to help them feel more comfortable and confident in their bodies. Over the course of one month, participants learn to use social media more consciously, critically reflect on unrealistic beauty ideals, and develop a kinder and more compassionate attitude toward themselves. They also complete short daily reflections about body image, self-compassion, and social media use.

A first study showed promising results: participants enjoyed using the app and reported positive changes. A larger scientific study is now being conducted to examine how effective the training really is and whether it can help improve body satisfaction and reduce fears of being judged for one’s appearance in the long term.
